My recommendation

Pick a favourite from the natural set (Chatterbox or CosyVoice 2 are the strongest non-AI-sounding options) and I’ll wire it in as the default narrator — no more Gemini Puck. If you’d rather it be a specific voice (yours, or a presenter’s), send me a 30–60s clean clip and I’ll clone it through the free endpoint.

How it plugs in: the recorder already generates the voiceover per video. Swapping the model is a one-line change in the pipeline’s TTS call — text in, WAV out — so whichever you choose applies to both uploaded recordings and live-URL walkthroughs. The paid line: only Free.ai’s ElevenLabs-powered “instant clone” needs purchased tokens; the self-hosted clone and all voices above ran on your free daily pool.
